Flex stack

Source: R/layout.R
shad_stack.Rd

A one-dimensional flex layout: children in a column (default) or a row, with a token-scale gap. The workhorse for "these things, spaced".

Usage

shad_stack(
  ...,
  direction = c("vertical", "horizontal"),
  gap = 4,
  align = NULL,
  justify = NULL,
  wrap = FALSE,
  fill = FALSE,
  class = NULL
)

Arguments

...

Children, or named HTML attributes for the root.

direction

"vertical" (default) or "horizontal".

gap

Gap between children: a spacing token step (default 4 = 1rem) or a CSS length.

align

Cross-axis alignment: "stretch" (default), "start", "center", "end", "baseline".

justify

Main-axis distribution: "start" (default), "center", "end", "between", "around", "evenly".

wrap

If TRUE, children wrap onto new lines.

fill

If TRUE, children share the free space equally.

class

Extra CSS classes.

Value

A <div> tag.

See also

Other shadshiny layout: shad_container(), shad_grid(), shad_page_navbar(), shad_page_sidebar()

Examples

shad_stack(shad_button("Save"), shad_button("Cancel", variant = "outline"),
           direction = "horizontal", gap = 2)
#> <div class="shad-stack" style="--shad-stack-dir:row;--shad-stack-gap:var(--shad-space-2);">
#>   <button type="button" class="shad-btn shad-btn--default">Save</button>
#>   <button type="button" class="shad-btn shad-btn--outline">Cancel</button>
#> </div>
